about_the_game:
Tidy up the Cosmic Abyss in Master Blaster!




Master Blaster is a simple, yet addictive aim-and-shoot chaotic game that combines old-school arcade action with tactical and strategic elements.

In Master Blaster, you find yourself in the shoes of a ultraversal entity, the enigmatic Master Blaster . Engage in sweaty cosmic battles against adversaries known as 'Chaosbringers' - the manifestations of the very forces of universal unpredictability .

Embark on an otherworldly, atmospheric journey where air hockey-inspired physics meets strategy , precision and intense blasting action! .



  • Blasting Arcade Action: From chill, casual gameplay to intense and fast-paced battles, you will unleash powerful blasts, activate new abilities, and engage in cosmic warfare!
  • Strategy and Precision: Apply precise, billiards inspired control to counter Chaosbringers' forces. Devise shooting strategies to maximize the impact of your shots!
  • Upgrade your abilities: Enhance your arsenal by unlocking new Blasters. Buff-up wisely to keep up your progression.
  • BlasterBoard: Place your name in Master Blaster’s Steam Leaderboard and BECOME the MASTER BLASTER!
  • Astro-Physics: Thrilling air-hockey inspired physics with a cosmic twist! Experience dynamic and unpredictable trajectories of Master Blaster’s cosmic arena!
  • Dark Humor: Immerse yourself in a universe of dark humor and quirky monologues (starring the enigmatic Chaosbringers!)
  • Cosmic Atmosphere: Supported by characteristic visuals, sounds and a cool arcade soundtrack!



  • Survival Mode: Test your abilities in 'Survival' mode where you battle to create universal order against random, chaotic states of play.
  • Story Mode: Transverse the map of the universe while you unravel the mysteries of the cosmic lore as you campaign to the final battle. As you progress, overcome challenges and discover the secrets hidden within the fabric of the universe.

Where Chaos prevails, everything relies on you.
The universe needs the ultimate blaster.
BE the MASTER BLASTER!

short_description: Master Blaster is a chaotic 'Aim-and-Shoot' game that combines classic arcade action with air-hockey physics and strategic, tactical and precision elements. Blast away against swarms of chaotic forces, deliver precision shots or plan your shots to restore cosmic order and become Master Blaster!
